items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] When we were over there with Kit Thomas.

ctx.x: When we were over there with Kit Thomas. It sounded nice on the record. That bow came through. You ought to hear it. I might hear it. I might hear it. I might hear it. I might hear it. I might hear it. I might hear it. Any other older men help you when you were young?
Well, just like I tell you, just two fellas from this side of you, they were from Laplace.
